title: telegram
description: The telegram plugin's settings: who may write, which bot opens a chat, and which plugins' pending items are also sent.

users.description: The Telegram user ids whose private messages become chat messages. A message from anyone else is recorded and answered with nothing.

bot.description: The bot a chat is opened on when a listed user writes first.

pending.description: The plugins whose pending items are also sent to Telegram, such as ["dev"]. Items of a chat bound to Telegram are always sent.
